definition: Evaluates a user-supplied, possibly vector-valued, mathematical expression per pixel across one or more input rasters, producing an output raster with one or more bands.

hasAction.description: The object identifier of this item moves from https://geolabs.github.io/bblocks-generic-profiles/def/activity-type/raster-band-math to https://w3id.org/geolabs/ospd/generic-profiles/activity-type/raster-band-math, which resolves through w3id.org (decision of 2026-11-17); the register actions of the item move with it, under https://w3id.org/geolabs/ospd/generic-profiles/activity-type/raster-band-math/actions/. The old IRI is kept as owl:sameAs. The content of the item is unchanged. Classified clarifying: the item is the same, only its identifier changes.

The activity type raster-band-math-multiband is merged into this one (decision of 2026-11-19), which now covers an output raster with one or more bands. The definition changes meaning; it was "Evaluates a user-supplied mathematical expression per pixel across one or more input rasters, producing a monoband output raster." The number of bands of the output is a matter of signature, already enforced by the dataType of each Implementation Profile's output (raster-single-band or raster), not of meaning. The Implementation Profiles raster-band-math and raster-band-math-multiband both point here. Classified substantive, a change of meaning.
With the merge of raster-band-math-multiband, its source on several bands is added here, OGC 09-146r8 Coverage Implementation Schema (CIS) 1.1.1, §6.5 RangeType. Classified clarifying, a source.

The parent class (rdfs:subClassOf) changes from https://w3id.org/ogc/rim/geoprocessing/GeoprocessingActivityType to the family https://w3id.org/geolabs/ospd/generic-profiles/activity-type/band-algebra, itself a sub-class of it (decision of 2026-11-19: activity types grouped by meaning). The definition and the entity types are unchanged. Classified substantive, a change of parent class.
